hypotheses.claim: Binance's in-kind restoration program could create incremental XRP market or OTC demand if a token-specific XRP shortfall remains.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: The $5B already held in affected token assets may already include sufficient XRP; existing inventory, frozen recoveries or internal transfers may satisfy the obligation without new spot purchases.

hypotheses.claim: The 234.9M XRP seven-day decline across tracked exchange wallets is close in magnitude to the 233.46M XRP incident transfer.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: Binance-specific same-wallet decline is 173.2M, below the theft amount; per-wallet daily balances are unavailable and other flows, offsets, wallet-set coverage and internal transfers are unresolved.

hypotheses.claim: XRP custody migrated from Binance to Coinbase after the incident.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: Coinbase rose only 1.1M XRP over seven days while Binance declined 173.2M; self-custody, other venues and internal wallet movements remain plausible.

hypotheses.claim: All five XRPL source accounts were included in Binance's official October 1 PoR wallet file.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: CoinDesk's documented Binance 14 PoR crosswalk is Ethereum-specific; provider labels alone do not prove official downloadable-file membership.
